jobs.description_html:
Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust.

 

In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.

 

  • Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment
  • Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories
  • Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance
  • Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness
  • Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models

 

Qualifications to succeed in this project:

 

  • Professional fluency in English
  • Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years  
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture
  • Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities
  • Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher)
  • Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred)

 

Why join the project:

 

  • Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling
  • Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains
  • Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment
  • Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly trustworthy, this work is built for that mindset.
  • Responsive support: Direct access to evaluation support staff for clarification on ambiguous queries or technical guidance
  Qualification path

How to get started:

  • Complete your contributor profile and application
  • Take a qualification assessment at your own pace within the time given
  • Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process
  • Acceptance form & Rater Academy: Complete an acceptance form and approximately 2.5 hours of Rater Academy training
  • Receive your project assignment and access credentials

 

Service Rates 

The rate of pay is 0.2333 USD per task, with an estimated earning potential of 14 USD per hour.

Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

 

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes.   • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Back-End

Front-End

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them.

We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone.

We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world.


What you'll do
  • Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way.
  • Write video scripts and outlines.
  • Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos.

What we're looking for
  • Native-level written and spoken English
  • Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently

  • A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise
  • Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload
  • Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada


Nice to have
  • Previous experience creating educational video content
  • Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about
  • Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos


Working at Metics Media

At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. Role Overview:

  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

What we’re looking for

  • Strong proficiency in React, Next.js, TypeScript/JavaScript.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS for production workloads.

  • Solid understanding of web security best practices (OWASP, secure storage, encryption in transit/at rest, secrets management).

  • Experience building systems in or adjacent to healthcare, education, or compliance-heavy environments is a plus.

  • Excellent async communication, code ownership, and ability to work with a small, senior-led team.

  • Comfort working from a clear product brief and also proposing improvements proactively.

  • Familiarity with logging, monitoring, and observability tools.

Take-home assignment (Step 1 of the process)

Please complete a take-home assignment. You are allowed to use LLMs to write code. To ensure that your work will not be used at Fluence, we’ve made it unrelated to healthcare:

Build “LendLoop”: a neighborhood tool-lending board with automated workflows

A simple app where neighbors list tools they are willing to lend, request to borrow from each other, and receive automated notifications and reminders handled by n8n.

Stack

  • Next.js (App Router)

  • Clerk for authentication

  • Convex for data + backend logic

  • n8n (self-hosted via Docker or n8n Cloud) for workflow automation

  • TypeScript

Requirements

Public page

  • The fictional company name is LendLoop.

  • Short tagline, e.g. “Borrow what you need. Lend what you don’t.”

  • Show:

  • A “Sign in to lend or borrow” button wired to Clerk.

Authenticated experience

  • Only signed-in users can:

  • List a tool with:

  • name

  • category (power tools, garden, kitchen, camping, etc.)

  • condition

  • short description

  • Request to borrow a tool for a date range.

  • Approve or decline requests on their own tools.

  • Mark a loan as returned.

  • Show:

  • All tools with availability status, filterable by category.

  • “My listings”, “My requests”, and “Incoming requests” views.

  • Nice, minimal layout.

Roles & rules

  • admin:

  • user:

    • Can create, edit, and delete only their own listings, and act only on requests involving their own tools or their own borrowing.

  • Implement the above role-based access control with best practices, enforced in Convex functions, not only in the UI.

  • Sign webhook payloads (e.g. HMAC with a shared secret) and verify signatures on the receiving side.

  • Keep secrets in environment variables and n8n credentials, never in code or exported workflow JSON.

  • Make write-backs idempotent so retries do not create duplicate records or reminders.

  • Handle failures with retries and an error workflow (or equivalent) so failed runs are visible and never fail silently.

BoWatt is building agentic requirements and systems engineering software for manufacturing.

Requirements

  • At least two years of experience in Customer Success, Implementation, Account Management, Solutions Consulting, or a similar customer-facing B2B software role

  • Alternatively, relevant experience in a technical customer-facing role at an industrial manufacturer, engineering company, or technology business

SANOVIO is the collaborative AI platform for healthcare procurement. Every euro a hospital loses in purchasing is missing in patient care. We help hospitals get good products at fair prices, with far less manual work.

Founded in 2024 in Munich by Noel Nosswitz, Alexander Hüttner and Yong Wang, we work with hospitals in Germany and Switzerland, purchasing groups and international suppliers. We are customer-funded: our customers are our only investors.

The role

As Technical Product Manager, you turn real procurement problems into working software. You sit between our hospital and supplier users, our engineering team and the founders. You decide what we build next, shape how it works, and often build the first version yourself.

You work on SANOVIO aOS and the internal tools behind our fulfillment operations: AI agents that clean item master data, workflows that move an order from request to ward, and integrations with hospital and supplier systems.

A large part of the role is talking to customers. You join calls and on-site visits with hospital purchasing teams, purchasing groups and suppliers, show them what we build, take their feedback and turn it into product decisions. You are a trusted contact for our customers on everything technical.

At Semperis, our mission is to be a Force for Good. Starting with being a great place to work. We believe that when people feel valued, supported, and empowered, they do their best work. A great opportunity to join Semperis as an Enterprise Sales Director to accelerate growth across Germany and help more enterprise organisations strengthen cyber resilience through identity-first security.

In this high-impact individual contributor role, you will manage a defined portfolio of named enterprise accounts, building executive relationships, shaping account strategies, and turning complex business challenges into high-value opportunities and wins.

You will drive net-new and expansion revenue through strategic prospecting, executive engagement, and partner collaboration, working closely with channel and alliance teams to extend Semperis’ reach and impact.

Trusted by some of the world’s largest enterprises and government agencies, Semperis brings deep expertise in protecting and recovering hybrid identity environments, including Active Directory, Entra ID, and Okta. As organisations navigate the AI era and increasingly complex identity risks, this is an exciting opportunity to lead with a distinctive platform in one of the most relevant and fast-moving areas of enterprise cybersecurity.

What you will do

  • Run strong discovery that connects customer challenges and business risks to Semperis solutions

  • Apply a structured sales methodology, including MEDDPICC, to qualification, deal strategy, stakeholder mapping, and forecast accuracy

  • Maintain disciplined pipeline management, forecasting, territory planning, and CRM hygiene

  • Represent Semperis at relevant industry events, customer forums, and executive engagements across Germany

  • Consistent creation of qualified enterprise pipeline across Germany

  • Strong control of complex sales cycles from first conversation through close

  • A clear market-ownership mindset, with the initiative to build relationships, awareness, and opportunity in territory

  • Executive presence in both German and English, with the ability to sell business value, resilience, risk reduction, and investment justification

  • Disciplined use of MEDDPICC to drive qualification, deal progression, and executive alignment

  • High activity, strong deal hygiene, and disciplined follow-through

  • The ability to establish Semperis as a trusted identity security and cyber resilience partner in the German enterprise market

What you will bring

  • Experience in Active Directory, Entra ID, identity security, or adjacent cyber categories is a strong plus

  • Technical and commercial credibility with both technical and business stakeholders

We’ve built an inclusive, flexible, and candid culture where you’re empowered to grow, take smart risks, and be unapologetically yourself (cape optional). Whether remote or in-office, we support how you thrive best. We invest in your well-being, development, and ability to make an impact because when one Nerd levels up, we all do.

The Consumer Banking org is responsible for owning the web shopping experiences for two of NerdWallet's largest and most mission-critical verticals. Our mission is to create best-in-class, data-driven financial marketplace experiences that help millions of users make smarter financial decisions. We build fast, intuitive, and highly optimized experiences that rank, perform, and scale, all while collaborating with business stakeholders, Paid Marketers and SEO strategists to drive measurable business impact. We use data to drive our decision making, running fast product-led experiments that deliver real business value, as well as contribute directly to the company’s strategic roadmap.

If you thrive on high-impact work, solving technical challenges, and shaping the future of financial shopping experiences on the web, this is the place for you.

About the role:

We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with a strong sense of product to join our team. You'll work across the stack, but your primary focus will be delivering modern, high-performance user experiences that balance speed, usability, and search visibility. You embrace AI development tools as part of your everyday workflow, using them to move faster without sacrificing quality.

You'll collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to build scalable, engaging shopping flows, while also contributing to performance, observability, accessibility, and technical excellence. This is a hands-on engineering role, ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, has a strong product mindset, and is motivated by seeing their work used by millions of users.

Where you can make an impact:

  • Build, maintain, and evolve React/Next.js front-end applications that serve millions of monthly users.

  • Improve Core Web Vitals, accessibility, and technical SEO to drive discoverability and engagement.

  • Partner with product, SEO, and content teams to launch, test, and iterate on high-impact shopping experiences.

  • Design and implement backend APIs and services that power dynamic, personalized content, rapid experimentation and partner integrations.

  • Collaborate on platform-wide initiatives: performance, observability, A/B testing infrastructure, and front-end developer experience.

  • Contribute to shared UI components and design systems, helping scale high-quality UX across pages.

  • Use AI coding tools and spec-driven workflows as part of your day-to-day, contributing to the team's growing dev harness and automations.

  • Participate in code reviews, mentorship, and team technical discussions to help raise the engineering bar.

Your experience:

We recognize not everyone will meet all of the criteria. If you meet most of the criteria below and you’re excited about the opportunity and willing to learn, we’d love to hear from you.

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience, with meaningful contributions across both front-end and back-end systems.

  • Deep experience in TypeScript, React.js, and Next.js or a related isomorphic framework (Astro, Gatsby, etc.).

  • Strong product and UX sensibility with a keen eye for performance, usability, and responsive design.

  • Hands-on experience building and consuming RESTful and GraphQL APIs, integrating with databases (SQL/NoSQL), and writing full-stack features.

  • Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (e.g. Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code) as part of your regular development workflow.

  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (e.g. AWS, GCP, Vercel) and modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, observability).

  • Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working in public-facing, high visibility shopping marketplaces.

  • Background in FinTech, financial services, or other regulated industries.

  • Hands-on experience with web vitals, lazy loading, caching strategies, or third-party analytics tools.

  • A technical blog, open-source contributions, or portfolio site showcasing your work.

Where:

  • This role will be remote (based in the U.S.).

  • We believe great work can be done anywhere. No matter where you are based, NerdWallet offers benefits and perks to support the physical, financial, and emotional well being of you and your family.

What we offer:

Work Hard, Stay Balanced (Life’s a series of balancing acts, eh?)

  • Industry-leading medical, dental, and vision health care plans for employees and their dependents

  • Rejuvenation Policy – Flexible Vacation Time Off + 11 holidays + holiday company shutdown

  • New Parent Leave for employees with a newborn child or a child placed with them for adoption or foster care

  • Mental health support

  • Paid sabbatical after 5 years for Nerds to recharge, gain knowledge, and pursue their interests

  • Health and Dependent Care FSA and HSA Plan with monthly NerdWallet contribution

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend, Cell Phone Stipend, and Wifi Stipend (Only remote Nerds are eligible for the Wifi Stipend)

  • Work from home equipment stipend and co-working space subsidy (Only remote Nerds are eligible for these stipends)

Have Some Fun! (Nerds are fun, too)

  • Nerd-led group initiatives – Employee Resource Groups for Parents, Diversity, and Inclusion, Women, LGBTQIA, and other communities

  • Hackathons and team events across all teams and departments

  • Company-wide events like NerdLove (employee appreciation) and our annual Charity Auction

  • Our Nerds love to make an impact by paying it forward – Take 8 hours of volunteer time off per quarter and donate to your favorite causes with a company match

Plan for your future (And when you retire on your island, remember the little people)

  • 401K with 4% company match

  • Be the first to test and benefit from our new financial products and tools

  • Financial wellness, guidance, and unlimited access to a Certified Financial Planner (CFP) through Northstar

  • Disability and Life Insurance with employer-paid premiums

jobs.description_html:
Clinical Informatics Specialist — Federal Health IT

Location: Remote — United States

Security Clearance: Active Secret required

Travel: Travel to designated federal healthcare facilities as needed

Apply Clinical Expertise. Improve Healthcare Workflows. Strengthen Clinical Technology.

At Rackner, we're advancing dependable healthcare technology in complex federal environments. We're seeking a Clinical Informatics Specialist who brings professional clinical expertise and informatics knowledge to the challenges healthcare professionals encounter when using electronic health record (EHR) systems. You'll help bridge the gap between clinical practice and technology, improving workflow reliability, user confidence, and the effectiveness of clinical applications.

This role offers an opportunity to apply clinical judgment beyond traditional care delivery, working alongside clinical and technical professionals to resolve complex workflow issues, strengthen clinical information accuracy, and improve how healthcare teams use technology. You'll contribute practical insights that help clinicians navigate challenges and maintain consistent, effective workflows.

What You'll Do

  • Diagnose complex clinical workflow issues, distinguishing application configuration concerns, workflow design gaps, training needs, and potential system defects to identify appropriate paths to resolution.
  • Coach clinicians on effective EHR workflows, addressing recurring challenges and reinforcing appropriate application use across supported healthcare environments.
  • Validate clinical content for accuracy and consistency, identifying discrepancies and recommending corrections before materials are finalized for publication.
  • Review the clinical appropriateness of designated access requests involving sensitive or privileged clinical roles, documenting preliminary findings for evaluation by authorized approvers.
  • Identify workflow adoption barriers and recurring operational issues, contributing clinical insights to performance reviews, corrective actions, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Coordinate with functional analysts, technical specialists, and clinical stakeholders to resolve issues requiring specialized clinical interpretation and multidisciplinary expertise.
  • Provide targeted clinical informatics assistance remotely and at designated healthcare facilities when persistent workflow challenges require onsite engagement.

What You'll Bring

  • Professional qualifications as a licensed registered nurse (RN) or other qualifying clinician.
  • A recognized professional certification in nursing or clinical informatics, such as ANCC Nursing Informatics Board Certification (NI-BC) or an accepted equivalent relevant to your clinical background.
  • At least 3 years of direct experience supporting clinical workflows on designated military healthcare EHR platforms. This position requires experience with specific clinical systems, which will be confirmed during the
  • recruiting process.
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate complex clinical workflow issues, apply sound clinical judgment, and distinguish clinical concerns from functional or technical problems.
  • Experience guiding clinical professionals through EHR workflows and communicating practical solutions to users with varying technical proficiency.
  • Ability to assess clinical information for accuracy, document findings clearly, and collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
  • An active U.S. Government Secret security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with clinical reporting tools, EHR usage analytics, or workflow adoption measurement.
  • Developing or contributing to clinical competency assessments.
  • Background supporting military medical operations or healthcare delivery within military environments.

Why Rackner?

At Rackner, you'll join a team focused on delivering practical technology solutions for important federal missions. We value professionals who combine subject-matter expertise with collaborative problem-solving and a commitment to continuous improvement.

You'll have the opportunity to apply your clinical informatics knowledge to meaningful healthcare technology challenges, work across clinical and technical disciplines, and contribute to solutions that make complex systems more effective for the professionals who rely on them.

Benefits & Perks

Rackner offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support professional development, financial well-being, and work-life balance. Depending on eligibility, benefits include:

  • Company-supported professional certifications and career development opportunities
  • 401(k) retirement plan with 100% company matching up to 6%
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Paid time off and paid holidays
  • Home-office equipment and remote-work support
  • Fitness and wellness reimbursement
  • Weekly pay and company team events

Work Arrangement

This is a remote position based in the United States. Travel to designated federal healthcare facilities may be required to address recurring clinical workflow challenges and provide specialized onsite assistance.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Rackner is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to any status protected by applicable law.

jobs.description_html:
At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

That’s why we’re seeking a Senior Project Manager accountable for managing multiple Cogstate projects overseeing the delivery of Cogstate Services. The Senior Project Manager will have experience with the pharmaceutical development process, a special aptitude and interest in scientific and technical information, an ability to motivate and mentor project and portfolio teams, and be a highly driven individual who demonstrates initiative and delivers against tight timelines in an agile environment. The Senior Project Manager will have demonstrated experience managing a full workload of clinical projects and/or internal development projects, and a growing awareness of information technology concepts and terminology and experience with direct and indirect people management. In addition, the Senior Project Manager will have confidence and composure in handling stressful situations, problem solving and communicating calmly and effectively with internal and external stakeholders, particularly in areas of disagreement.

This role will require extensive communication and interactions across multiple time zones with staff, Sponsors and clinical sites in countries all over the world.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage projects and execute tasks in line with company SOPs and agreed regulatory standards, including the following tasks:
  • Manage client relationships as main POC for individual studies and some sponsor portfolios.
    • Independently lead Cogstate’s complex global clinical trials projects – including implementation of projects with new service offerings in scope, where feedback is necessary to the development and commercialization teams to improve process.
  • Manage Clinical Trials projects in Start-Up, Conduct or Close-Out phases (multiple projects at one time).
    • Proactively manage risks with confidence, demonstrating strong leadership in guiding team members through challenges and making decisive, well-informed decisions.
  • Attending Investigator Meetings (as needed) and ensuring Cogstate is well represented.
  • Work in an Agile environment with a given Portfolio Team.
    • Oversight of resourcing and financials across a Portfolio of Projects- ensure team members follow pre-determined hours allocated in budget to target gross profit consistently
  • Generate invoices for assigned projects in alignment with expected timelines and project progress. Maintain a strong understanding of the broader impact of invoicing on company financials.
  • Actively maintain the change order process.
  • Oversee internal projects focused on developing processes for implementing new technologies, with the ability to map, visualize, and optimize workflows to support commercialization and scaling efforts
  • Develop operational deployment plans for new systems, including training, and operate as the point person for support.
  • Work closely with Business Development and project team managing relationship and supporting proposals for key accounts.
  • Potential to line manage or indirectly manage and mentor other project management team members and clinical operations staff in the future.
  • Analyze reports for project hours and budget utilization and making course corrections in conjunction with Operations Line Managers.
  • Forecast invoicing based on expected timeline and progress of the study
  • Ability to review Work Orders and determine deliverables and timelines for project.
  • Ensure accurate reporting to internal and external stakeholders on service delivery and progress.
  • People/Staff management: Demonstrate high performance in mentoring other project management team members and clinical staff.
  • Develop/contribute to playbooks for new Sponsors/Partners/systems, including training, and operate as the point person for support.
  • Participate in internal and external audits and inspections.
  • Support metrics reporting to sponsors.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in a scientific, business or a technical discipline (psychology, nursing, biology, sociology, computer science or engineering). Master’s preferred (science or business) but not mandatory.
  • PMP Certification (preferred but not mandatory).
  • Previous CRO experience preferable.
  • Previous CNS experience.
  • 7+ Years Project Management experience in Pharmaceutical, Biotech, or CRO environment.
  • Supervisory/mentoring experience (preferred but not mandatory).
  • Relationship Management Experience.
  • Microsoft Office proficiency.
  • Budget management experience

What’s In It For You

  • Remote Work Practices: Cogstate is a virtual first company. Cogstate employees can work from anywhere where Cogstate is registered to business within the United States, Australia, or the United Kingdom!
  • Bonus Scheme: This position is eligible to participate in Cogstate’s annual incentive program, with a target bonus opportunity of 10% of base salary, subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan.
  • Generous Paid Time-off: Cogstate employees receive 20 days of vacation leave, 10 days of personal leave and 10 paid public holidays.
  • 401(k) Matching: As you invest in yourself and your future, Cogstate invests in you too: we match up to3% of your yearly salary in Cogstate’s 401k program.
  • Competitive Salary: We offer competitive base salaries plus additional earning opportunities based on the position.
  • Health, Dental & Vision Coverage: We've invested in comprehensive health & dental insurance options with competitive company contributions to help when you need it most. We also offer free vision insurance for all full-time employees.
  • Short-Term & Long Term Disability Life Insurance: 100% employer sponsored
  • Pre-Tax Benefits: Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Learning & Development Opportunities: Cogstate offers a robust learning program from mentorships to assistance with programs to improve knowledge or obtain certifications in applicable areas of interest.

Wage Range

$125,000—$135,000 USD

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you’re ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

jobs.description_html:
Company Overview

Kairos Power is a new nuclear energy technology and engineering company whose mission is to enable the world’s transition to clean energy, with the ultimate goal to dramatically improve people’s quality of life while protecting the environment. This goal will be accomplished through the commercialization of the fluoride-salt-cooled, high-temperature reactor (FHR) that can be deployed with robust safety, affordable costs, and flexible operation to accommodate the expansion of variable renewables.

Job Summary

We are seeking an IT Systems Administrator II to support and maintain our cloud, on-premises, and SaaS platforms. This role is responsible for the administration, security, automation, and optimization of enterprise infrastructure across AWS, Microsoft, and on-premises environments. The successful candidate will partner with business stakeholders and software vendors to support business-critical applications, upgrades, integrations, and implementations while ensuring the reliability, security, and performance of underlying infrastructure and services. The ideal candidate has experience supporting enterprise infrastructure in a regulated environment and embraces an automation-first approach to systems administration, leveraging Infrastructure as Code, scripting, and modern IT operational practices.

Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, administer, maintain, and optimize infrastructure, services, and applications across AWS, SaaS, and on-premises environments.
  • Administer and support Microsoft Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, DNS, DHCP, file services, identity management, and Single Sign-On (SSO) integrations.
  • Develop, maintain, and improve automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, PowerShell, or similar technologies 
  • Monitor system health, performance, security, and availability; investigate and troubleshoot complex infrastructure, cloud, identity, and application issues.
  • Implement and maintain security controls, patch management, vulnerability remediation, and least-privilege access practices.
  • Provide technical support for business-critical enterprise applications and collaborate with business stakeholders and software vendors to support operations, integrations, upgrades, and implementations.
  • Participate in change management activities and support application and infrastructure deployments, migrations, testing, upgrades, and production changes.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, standards, procedures, and knowledge base articles.
  • Provide technical guidance and knowledge sharing to employees and junior IT staff.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of progressively responsible experience as a Systems Administrator, Cloud Administrator, Site Reliability Engineer, or similar role in a complex enterprise environment
  • Strong experience administering Microsoft Windows Server environments, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365 services, identity management, and SSO integrations,
  • Working knowledge of Linux server administration in AWS and hybrid-cloud environments
  • Demonstrated experience administering AWS infrastructure, including services such as EC2, IAM, VPC, Route 53, Systems Manager, FSx, CloudWatch, and related AWS technologies 
  • Strong scripting and automation experience using PowerShell and AWS CLI 
  • Experience supporting SaaS, cloud-native, hybrid-cloud, and on-premises applications and infrastructure 
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field preferred
  • 8+ years of overall IT experience is preferred
  • Terraform and Ansible experience is preferred
  • Nutanix AHV administration experience is preferred
  • Advanced Microsoft Windows Server and Active Directory administration experience is preferred
  • Experience supporting application integrations, APIs, SQL databases, and reporting platforms is preferred
  • Experience working with software vendors during upgrades, implementations, and troubleshooting efforts is preferred
  • Experience supporting engineering, manufacturing, laboratory, or quality-focused organizations is preferred
  • Experience working in high-growth organizations undergoing technology transformation is preferred
  • Prior work experience in a fast-paced, high-growth startup is preferred

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Working knowledge of networking, databases, backup and recovery, and disaster recovery concepts 
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, vulnerability management, patch management, and security best practices 
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills 
  • Resourceful problem-solver with a service-oriented mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
  • Knowledge of cloud and hybrid infrastructure administration principles, including AWS, Microsoft, SaaS, and on-premises environments
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC), configuration management, scripting, and systems automation practices
  • Knowledge of identity and access management principles, including Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Single Sign-On, and least-privilege access
  • Ability to monitor and assess system health, performance, availability, and capacity across enterprise infrastructure and services
  • Knowledge of change management practices related to infrastructure and application deployments, migrations, upgrades, and production changes
  • Ability to support and coordinate application integrations, implementations, and upgrades across internal stakeholders and third-party vendors
  • Ability to develop and maintain technical standards, procedures, and system administration documentation
  • Ability to provide technical guidance and knowledge sharing to employees and less-experienced IT staff

Physical Demands

  • Remaining in a stationary position, often standing, or sitting for prolonged periods
  • Communicating with others to exchange information

Environmental Conditions

  • General office environment
  • Noisy environments
  • Prototyping/Test Facilities
  • Manufacturing/Industrial Environments

Travel

  • Some travel may be required, up to 5%

Additional Requirements

jobs.description_html:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As an Enterprise Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will drive business growth by identifying opportunities with target clients. You’ll play a pivotal role in identifying potential customers, generating new business opportunities, and providing support to both customers and our team. You will set the stage for successful sales interactions through cold outreach efforts and nurturing relationships to secure qualified meetings for our sales team. If you’re a self-motivated individual with a passion for sales, we encourage you to join our team!

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Sales: Understand current and future demand. Enable, educate, and directly support the sales force to best position this practice with Toptal clients and win new business. Lead client conversations, presenting Toptal’s perspective on innovation and experience topics, and ask exploratory questions to better understand client needs.
  • Begin the Relationship: Through lead-generation activities and cold-calling, you will prospect, educate, qualify, and develop sales-ready leads and opportunities from unsigned clients and accounts. You will enthusiastically explain Toptal’s vision, pinpoint opportunities, and generate interest.
  • Client and Industry Knowledge: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. As the first point of contact for future Enterprise clients, you will be building rapport through strategic outreach and a well-rounded client and industry knowledge. Researching clients and staying informed on industry trends will be key to your success.
  • Collaborate with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team and Sales Executives to pursue opportunities, recommend appropriate follow-up actions, and schedule qualified meetings. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team.
  • Growth and Development: Our team has an aversion to complacency. We are always looking to improve both individually and as a team. Being open to and implementing feedback will be critical success factors in this role and at Toptal. As you become more comfortable in the role, you will help evolve our demand generation strategy and tactics.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our story.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to understand how you can utilize our incredible global team to build client relationships and drive success.
  • Learn the breadth of Toptal’s impact on the world’s largest companies.
  • Grasp the importance of the SDR function to the success of Toptal.
  • Understand our sales method and our selling process to set you up for success.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Complete our personalized sales training program with mock calls, cold calls, and role-play scenarios.
  • Learn how to use Salesforce.com (our CRM) and other SaaS outreach tools (ZoomInfo, SalesLoft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).
  • Integrate into your pod, partner with Enterprise Sales Executives and Client Partners, and begin targeting strategic accounts.
  • Learn the process for outreach, including calling, emailing, and LinkedIn messaging. Implement an outreach process and hit 1-month objectives.
  • Learn how to analyze industry drivers, business problems, and target buyers.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Become fully ramped on the SDR team, attaining your metrics, which include calls, emails, and other sales activities.
  • Exercising discretion and independent judgment, uncover new opportunities within existing accounts and target accounts that result in revenue-generating engagements for Toptal.
  • Hit call/email quotas and fully ramped objectives.
  • Become proficient in using our SaaS tools.
  • Learn how to maintain excellent data integrity in Salesforce.com.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Continuously hit fully ramped quotas and objectives.
  • Assist with training and onboarding new SDRs.
  • Build new and existing client relationships, expand Toptal’s partnerships, and continue to execute account plans.
  • Suggest, implement, and experiment with new lead and demand generation activities.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Have built a portfolio of net new accounts from the strategic account list.
  • Become a mentor to new members of the team, helping them learn about Toptal, our model, and how proper sales development practices can improve relationships and increase revenue.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 1 year of experience as an Enterprise SDR.
  • Knowledgeable. Broad understanding of business challenges encountered by Enterprise clients.
  • Critical thinking. Critically think through the challenges clients face to create new opportunities from unsigned clients and accounts.
  • Perseverance. Be relentless and push towards your goal.
  • Passion. Enthusiasm and ambition to succeed in this role, as it can be difficult if you hate rejection.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Curiosity. A desire to understand people, their problems, their companies, and their industries.
  • Conscientiousness. We’re not doing a simple SaaS sale, so discussions may get technical. Understanding sophisticated issues and explaining them to clients is important.
  • Motivated. Be highly motivated and continuously strive for personal and professional improvement.
  • Resourceful. Think about target accounts as your own business - we want self-starters who are passionate about hunting for new accounts, and who thrive with the freedom and accountability of leading their portion of the business.
  • Proactive. Understand our mission and do the work required to drive us to that goal, by following a process and being creative.
  • Communication. You must exhibit outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Communication is the lifeblood of both internal and external relationships. Demonstrate excellent communication in all forms, across a wide variety of personality types, roles, and geographies.
  • Team. Nothing we do is done in isolation. Success depends on your ability to work as a team both within Toptal and within your client accounts.
  • Ownership. Exhibit ownership of accounts, successes, and failures.
  • Problem Solver. Life throws in minor challenges beyond the primary problems this role is meant to solve. You must have the ability to take those in stride and persist despite setbacks.
  • Prioritization. The nature of this role requires that you understand the priorities and timelines associated with each of your accounts and execute appropriately with those in mind.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Compensation

Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

About 6sense

Over the last 18 months, we have been transforming 6sense from a traditional ABM provider into a destination and partner for our customers’ agentic go-to-market.

We are well positioned to lead. Our intelligence rests on 13 years of enterprise buyer data, more than one billion intent signals, and a semantic context layer that makes every signal explainable. This differentiated data layer is a strong moat for our business and differentiates our agents and activations.

6sense combines a healthy enterprise software business with fast-growing advertising (20% growth) and data and intelligence (20% growth) businesses, alongside emerging businesses in managed services and agentic activations. Enterprise customers including Cisco, NetApp, Thomson Reuters, Dell, and NVIDIA trust us with their go-to-market.

The Opportunity

Our product offerings are ready, but the market does not know it yet. We carry a legacy brand in a quiet category, and our product has moved faster than our story. Our Board and executive team are committed to investing in marketing and building a category-leading company.

We’re looking for a Vice President of Storytelling & Communications to reposition 6sense, define and shape the agentic go-to-market category, and make our story impossible to ignore and easy to repeat. In partnership with leadership, you’ll set the strategy and execute it through internal use cases, thought leadership, customer stories, influencers, and communications that educate the market on our new offerings.

This is not a traditional content leadership role. You’ll own our content editorial strategy and agenda and be one of the people telling the story yourself. The role combines a storyteller’s instincts, an evangelist’s presence, the strategic judgment of a senior marketing leader, and the discipline to lead an AI-enabled content and communications organization.

What You’ll Own

Define the Narrative and Shape the Category

  • Partner with the CMO and executive leadership team to reposition 6sense and define and shape the agentic go-to-market category. Establish the point of view, language, and frameworks that help the market understand what is changing, why it matters, and why 6sense should lead.
  • Build one narrative architecture connecting company strategy, product innovation, customer proof, thought leadership research, and executive voice. Partner with Product Marketing and Brand to make our story differentiated, credible, and consistent across audiences and channels.
  • Lead sustained market education on how agentic go-to-market changes the way teams work, where people and agents fit, and how customers can begin the transition.
  • Turn customer insight, internal use cases, and product innovation into evidence-led stories. Mobilize executives, customers, and influencers to carry those ideas into the market, and assess whether they are changing understanding and earning adoption. 

Lead the Team and Content Strategy 

  • Lead an approximately five-person team spanning earned media/PR, executive communications/internal communications, social media/influencer marketing, content strategy/blog, and customer stories.
  • Coach and develop the team; set clear priorities and editorial standards. Build AI-enabled ways of working that increase leverage without compromising quality, trust, or voice. Focus resources on stories that move the market rather than content that fills a calendar.
  • Set the voice and storytelling principles that make our work unmistakably ours. Bring customer stories to the center of the narrative and adapt strong ideas across editorial, social, earned media, campaigns, and executive channels.

Build Market Influence and Executive Voice 

  • Be a visible company spokesperson on stages, in media, on podcasts, and at customer and industry events. Build relationships with journalists, analysts, influencers, customers, and partners that help us lead the conversation.
  • Partner with the CEO, CMO, and executive team on keynote narratives, thought leadership, and major company moments. Challenge ideas constructively and help executives turn complexity into compelling stories.

Connect Employees and Drive Growth 

  • Own the internal narrative and content for executive messaging, company-wide meetings, organizational announcements, and employee storytelling. Help employees understand our strategy, progress, and culture—and tell a consistent story themselves.
  • Partner with Revenue Marketing, Product Marketing, Customer Marketing, Brand, Sales, Product, and GTM Enablement to bring the narrative into launches, campaigns, customer moments, and field-ready conversations that support consideration, advocacy, pipeline, and expansion.

What Success Looks Like 

The market can explain what 6sense stands for and why we are different. Our category language and research earn attention and adoption; executives become recognized voices; customers become central storytellers; and employees and sales teams tell a coherent, compelling story. We measure influence, buyer engagement, advocacy, and growth—not publishing volume alone.

What You Bring 

  • Significant leadership experience across content, communications, thought leadership, research, brand storytelling, or corporate marketing, with the ability to connect these disciplines into a coherent strategy.
  • A body of work demonstrating exceptional storytelling and measurable impact on market perception, buyer engagement, customer advocacy, sales effectiveness, or growth. You simplify complex ideas without making them simplistic.
  • Experience building or repositioning a corporate narrative during a growth, transformation, category, or market transition. You can develop a distinctive point of view, challenge conventional thinking, and translate it into market education and category-shaping work.
  • Experience setting a thought leadership and research agenda and turning evidence into original ideas, influential stories, and executive platforms—not simply managing content production.
  • Strong understanding of B2B buying committees, sales cycles, and competitive differentiation. You connect narrative to positioning, brand, demand, customer marketing, and commercial outcomes.
  • Fluency in AI and agentic technology sufficient to ask discerning questions, distinguish meaningful differentiation from noise, and work with Product and technical leaders on a credible story. You also know how to use AI without compromising quality, trust, or voice.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, verbal communication, and presentation skills. You are comfortable in the boardroom and on stage, working with C-suite leaders, journalists, customers, and industry influencers, and developing executives into stronger external voices.
  • A record of leading multidisciplinary teams and senior-level talent: hiring, coaching, prioritizing, and giving sharp creative feedback. You influence across functions through credibility and conviction and move fluidly between strategy and hands-on work.

Who This Role Is For 

You may currently lead Content, Corporate Communications, Brand, Editorial, Product Marketing, or Thought Leadership at the VP level, or have served as a Chief Evangelist while building and leading a team. Your background matters less than your ability to find the story, shape it, mobilize an organization around it, and tell it yourself.

The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. At NerdWallet, we’re on a mission to bring clarity to all of life’s financial decisions and every great mission needs a team of exceptional Nerds. We’ve built an inclusive, flexible, and candid culture where you’re empowered to grow, take smart risks, and be unapologetically yourself (cape optional). Whether remote or in-office, we support how you thrive best. We invest in your well-being, development, and ability to make an impact because when one Nerd levels up, we all do.

The Consumer Web Product team owns web shopping experiences for one of NerdWallet's largest and most mission-critical verticals, serving millions of users making real financial decisions. You'll work across a modern full-stack: Next.js and React on the frontend, GraphQL federation and Node.js services on the backend, deployed on edge infrastructure built for scale and speed. Page performance and Core Web Vitals directly move rankings, conversion, and revenue, so the technical work here has a visible, measurable business impact. We build fast, and we build with data: rapid product-led experimentation, direct input into the company's strategic roadmap, and close collaboration with Paid Marketing and SEO strategists to turn engineering decisions into business outcomes.

If you thrive on high-impact work, solving technical challenges, and shaping the future of financial shopping experiences on the web, this is the place for you.

We're looking for a hands-on player coach Tech Lead Manager to lead the Consumer Facing Web Product team. You act as a pace setter and multiplier for the team, helping to mentor and build your team up to your standards of execution. You'll be deeply involved with the technical day-to-day of the team, helping the team to deliver on the product backlog, contributing to the engineering excellence roadmap, setting architectural direction and ensuring high-quality delivery throughout. You'll be diving in when needed to help set the standards and drive quality. You'll also be responsible for the people management for a team of 3-4 engineers: 1-on-1s, career development and performance management. You bring strong technical judgement to the role, having experience being the senior-most engineer on your team. You avoid micromanagement, choosing to lead through influence and mutual respect rather than authority. You're as excited about delivering high-quality work as you are finding opportunities to unlock growth for your people.

You embrace AI development tools and modern engineering practices, focusing on balancing quality with delivery velocity. You're using AI tools to reshape the Software Development Lifecycle, delegating as much to your team as you are to agentic workflows. You will help the team build out a robust AI developer harness, utilize a consistent spec-driven development workflow and integrate AI skills into every facet of process: from architecture & planning to development, QA, code review and release. You are creating agentic workflows to automate away the toil from your day to day, as well as your team's, with the right guardrails in place to keep quality and compliance high as you go.

You'll collaborate closely with stakeholders from across the organization, including: SEO strategists, Paid Marketers, Product, Business Development, Data & Analytics, etc. to drive meaningful business value, focusing your efforts on growing the business rather than engineering for the sake of it.

This role reports to the Head of Engineering for Consumer Banking, Credit Cards & New Markets.

Where you can make an impact:

  • Own both the technical direction and the people outcomes for a team building some of NerdWallet's highest-traffic web shopping experiences.

  • Drive architecture, technical decisions, planning, and milestones.

  • Build and evolve the team's AI dev harness and orchestrate agentic automations across the software lifecycle, from spec to review to deployment.

  • Develop your engineers' AI-era skills: effective prompting, spec-writing, and reviewing AI-generated code and designs.

  • Manage and develop your engineers: run 1:1s, give feedback, set growth plans, and hold a performance bar.

  • Take input from and partner directly with engineering leadership to drive technical initiatives that enhance performance, observability, scalability, security, and developer experience.

  • Contribute to platform stability and resilience through effective monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident management.

  • Ensure high standards of technical excellence, maintaining a high-quality codebase and driving modernization efforts including AI tooling adoption.

Your experience:

We recognize not everyone will meet all of the criteria. If you meet most of the criteria below and you're excited about the opportunity and willing to learn, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 8+ years in software engineering with a strong background as a hands-on Technical Lead.

  • Expertise in TypeScript, React and Node.js, with experience in additional modern languages.

  • Strong experience with modern front-end frameworks such as Next.js and React.js, with an understanding of web performance, Core Web Vitals, and technical SEO.

  • Experience architecting and building back-end APIs and microservices, with a focus on scalability, performance, and data integrity.

  • Strong understanding of database systems (both SQL and NoSQL), with experience in high-volume data processing.

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and orchestration technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Knowledge of security and compliance best practices, particularly in financial services.

  • Experience in observability and running production applications, especially marketplaces, at scale.

  • Hands-on experience with AI development tools and advanced AI-enabled development workflows: building a development harness, agentic automations / workflows, spec-driven development, etc.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • Experience with integrating Machine Learning systems, personalization pipelines, and data-driven experimentation.

  • Domain knowledge in finance and shopping marketplaces.

  • Understanding of accessibility best practices and a keen eye for usability and user experience.

  • Familiarity with paid and organic search strategies and how engineering decisions impact business outcomes.

What we offer:

Work Hard, Stay Balanced (Life’s a series of balancing acts, eh?)

  • Industry-leading medical, dental, and vision health care plans for employees and their dependents

  • Rejuvenation Policy – Flexible Vacation Time Off + 11 holidays + holiday company shutdown

Join Rackner to build secure backend services that support mission-planning and decision-support capabilities for a Department of Defense customer.

You will take hands-on ownership of APIs, service integrations, data flows, distributed workflows, and automated testing—not simply complete isolated development tickets.     WIN is seeking highly skilled, hands-on Software Engineers to help build innovative digital applications, AI-powered solutions, and scalable technology platforms.

    REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Solutions Consultants, Post-Sales at Ramp partner with Account Management to deepen and expand relationships with existing Ramp customers. You'll act as the technical and financial subject matter expert across the customer lifecycle — running product demonstrations to expand customers onto new Ramp products, while bringing the depth needed to resolve complex ERP integrations, configuration challenges, and technical blockers.

You'll collaborate closely with Account Managers to assess requirements, design scalable solutions, and ensure fast time-to-value as customers grow with Ramp. You will partner with Post-Sales teams to drive Product, Design and Engineering teams' roadmaps to evolve Ramp to better serve our customers at scale and offer increasingly higher value to the customers. This role requires strong technical skills — comfort with APIs, ERP systems, and integration architecture — paired with the communication ability to translate complexity into clear business value for finance and operations stakeholders.

This role is focused on Commercial and Mid-Market customers, supporting high-growth companies with standardized financial workflows and core ERP integrations.

What You'll Do

  • Evaluate customer requirements for expansion opportunities, assessing fit through use-case analysis, ROI assessments, and technical scoping

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity

Grafana Labs is looking for an Analyst Relations (AR) Manager to own our relationships with the industry analyst community, including Gartner, Forrester, IDC, GigaOm, and others, and to run the programs that turn those relationships into visibility, credibility, and pipeline influence. You'll manage the full analyst lifecycle: building and nurturing analyst relationships, running Analyst Days, driving our participation in Magic Quadrants and other evaluations, managing commissioned research, and partnering with analyst firms on joint surveys and reports. This role sits at the intersection of product marketing, communications, and competitive intelligence, and reports to the Director of AR and PR.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Analyst Relationship Management
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for a defined portfolio of analysts across Gartner, Forrester, IDC, GigaOm, and other relevant firms, building long-term, trusted relationships.
    • Maintain a regular cadence of proactive briefings, inquiry calls, and informal check-ins to keep analysts current on Grafana Labs' roadmap, customer momentum, and market position.
    • Plan and run Analyst Day(s), including agenda design, executive and SME participation, content development, and post-event follow-up.
    • Track analyst coverage, sentiment, and points of view on Grafana Labs and the observability market, and share that intelligence internally.
  • Evaluations & Commissioned Research
    • Own end-to-end submission management for Magic Quadrants, Forrester Waves, GigaOm Radars, and comparable evaluations, tracking deadlines, coordinating inputs, and managing the submission and rebuttal process.
    • Manage development of commissioned/sponsored reports (e.g., Total Economic Impact studies, custom research), including scoping, vendor selection, budget, and stakeholder review.
    • Design and field surveys and joint research initiatives in partnership with analyst firms, from questionnaire design through report publication and internal/external distribution.
    • Maintain a shared calendar of all evaluation cycles, submission windows, and research deliverables across the AR program.
  • Content, Enablement & Cross-Functional Coordination
    • Prepare executives and subject-matter experts for analyst briefings and inquiries, including briefing decks, talking points, and Q&A prep.
    • Build and maintain the AR content library: positioning documents, fact sheets, RFI/questionnaire responses, and reusable proof points.
    • Partner with product marketing, competitive intelligence, PR/comms, and the executive team to align analyst messaging with the broader company narrative and launch timing.
  • Program Measurement & Operations
    • Define and report on AR program KPIs, including evaluation positioning trends, share of voice, analyst-influenced pipeline, and stakeholder satisfaction.
    • Own the AR budget, including analyst firm subscriptions/contracts and commissioned research spend; manage vendor relationships and renewals.
    • Monitor for and coordinate rapid response to analyst commentary that could affect brand or competitive positioning.
    • Synthesize and distribute analyst research and competitive insight internally (e.g., briefing summaries, an internal analyst newsletter) to keep sales, product, and leadership informed.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • 6+ years of experience in analyst relations, communications, product marketing, or competitive intelligence, ideally in B2B SaaS or infrastructure/observability/monitoring software.
  • Direct experience managing Magic Quadrant, Wave, or similar analyst evaluation submissions.
  • Proven experience using AI to support workflows and build automations/applications.
  • Established familiarity with major analyst firms (Gartner, Forrester, IDC, GigaOm) and their methodologies.
  • Experience commissioning or managing third-party research (e.g., TEI studies, custom surveys).
  • Strong project management skills; comfortable owning multiple concurrent deadlines across teams.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the polish to prep and coach executives.
  • Data-literate: comfortable scoping surveys, interpreting research results, and translating findings into narrative.
  • Collaborative, cross-functional operator who can influence without direct authority.
  • Willingness to travel for analyst events and briefings (~15–20%).

Bonus Points For

  • Experience in observability, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, or open-source software markets.
  • Prior in-house AR leadership role (owned the function, not just supported it).

We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

Role Description

As a Senior Offensive Security Engineer within Dropbox Security, you will investigate how attackers could compromise our products and infrastructure, including AI-enabled applications and agentic systems. You will help identify meaningful attack paths and improve the controls intended to prevent, detect or contain them.

This is a hands-on offensive security and threat research role with broad scope and meaningful impact. You will independently define and lead complex investigations and multi-phase red team exercises, prioritize work based on risk, develop new attack techniques, and build tooling and automation that expand the reach of our security testing. You will combine practical AI security expertise with broader offensive security skills across applications, cloud infrastructure, and identity systems. Working closely with Product Security, Detection & Response, Threat Intelligence, Privacy, and engineering teams, you will translate technical findings into clear business risk, recommend practical improvements, and validate their effectiveness through retesting. Sound judgment, clear communication, responsible execution, and ownership through verified outcomes are essential to the role. You will help shape the Red Team’s technical direction while strengthening its tools, research methods, and testing practices. Alongside experienced researchers, you will bring your own areas of expertise, investigate emerging technologies, and advance Dropbox’s offensive security capabilities, with opportunities to deepen your expertise, publish research, and see your work directly influence security decisions across Dropbox.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

  • Plan and execute offensive security assessments by defining objectives, scope, rules of engagement, and safeguards, adapting your approach as new evidence emerges.
  • Investigate unfamiliar applications, infrastructure, APIs, and trust boundaries to identify and trace meaningful attack paths.
  • Develop and safely demonstrate exploits and attack chains that clearly establish potential impact to Dropbox.
  • Build and improve offensive security tools, agents, automation, and testing harnesses, ensuring results are reliable, repeatable, and appropriately validated.
  • Assess security risks across AI-enabled applications, agents, tool integrations, and supporting infrastructure, including the responsible use of AI-assisted research techniques.
  • Partner with security, privacy, legal, and engineering teams to communicate risk, strengthen prevention and detection capabilities, address root causes, and verify improvements through retesting.
  • Share research, mentor colleagues and improve the team’s methods through lessons from completed work.

Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non-core business hours. If a team has an on-call rotation, all engineers on the team are expected to participate in the rotation as part of their employment. Applicants are encouraged to ask for more details of the rotations to which the applicant is applying.

Requirements

  • 9+ years in offensive security, vulnerability research, red teaming or closely related security engineering, or equivalent demonstrated capability.
  • A track record of independently leading complex investigations or engagements and discovering and exploiting non-trivial vulnerabilities.
  • Understanding of application security, authentication and authorisation, cloud infrastructure, APIs and software supply chains, with deep practical expertise in one or more areas and the ability to trace attack paths across systems and trust boundaries.
  • Hands-on experience attacking or evaluating LLMs, AI agents, ML systems, AI-enabled applications, or agentic architectures.
  • Familiarity with security risks in AI-enabled applications, agents and tool integrations, and the ability to investigate unfamiliar technologies.
  • Ability to write code to build or adapt offensive tools and automation, and to read and investigate unfamiliar production codebases.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing novel attacks, repeatable security evaluations or testing frameworks for AI-enabled systems, or building and validating AI-assisted offensive research capabilities.
  • Expertise across multiple attack surfaces, or advanced specialist capability in areas such as exploit development, reverse engineering, endpoint security, cloud exploitation or software supply-chain attacks.
  • Experience developing automated vulnerability discovery, fuzzing, program analysis or evaluation systems across large codebases or complex environments.
  • Experience conducting coordinated exercises with defenders to measure detection and response effectiveness and validate improvements against realistic attack techniques.
  • Contributions through original research, vulnerability disclosures, open-source tools, technical publications, internal training or mentoring.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.
